summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed, CENT and the three method names; exact integer arithmetic, no decimal context), routed every rounding and fixed-places format in tariffs, standing, tax, cash, credits and report through it, removed the context line from __init__.py, and added tests/test_money.py. A differential fuzz of the CLI against the original (15,918 runs over random books, accounts and quotes, every command and format) showed no differences, and the 40 tests pass. Quirks kept on purpose: batch rounds band charges and the effective price half-even (pool threads had a fresh half-even decimal context) while bill/quote round half-up; the whole-unit cash rule never prints '-0' although the other rules can print '-0.00'; the settled-credit float arithmetic is unchanged.
